qs.q: In the review of dural venous sinuses, the tentorium cerebelli requires sensory innervation for pain sensation. What is the main nerve supplying the tentorium cerebelli?
o: Meningeal branches of the vagus nerve
Ophthalmic division of the trigeminal nerve
Meningeal branch of the mandibular nerve
qs.e: The tentorium cerebelli is mainly supplied by meningeal branches of the vagus nerve, whereas other intracranial dura structures receive innervation from trigeminal branches.
